title: Crispy Pork Dumplings
description: A classic Chinese dish made with juicy pork and crispy wrappers. Serve as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Combine pork, garlic, and soy sauce in a bowl. Mix well.
Lay a wonton wrapper on a flat surface. Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with water. Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Heat 2 inches of oil in a wok or deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few dumplings to the pan (do not overcrowd).
Fry the dumplings until they are golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Remove the dumplings from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
